secondary_stall.cause: Fatal-signal handler invokes printf which re-enters free while the fault-interrupted allocator lock is held by the same thread.

limits: The source of invalid heap metadata remains unproven: double release, invalid allocation lifetime or other corruption have not been distinguished.
Widened cluster layout proves layout/state change, not decoded video or successful map rendering.
Recovery after partially completed teardown has not yet been verified on the car.
